description: Configure the new-member onboarding flow on a Community server: prompts with options that grant channels and roles, the default channels every member sees, and the enabled state. Discord's app asks for at least seven default channels when configuring this by hand; the API has been observed to accept fewer. Members pick these options themselves, so offering a role that gives moderator or admin powers, or opens channels hidden from everyone, needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token saves it.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

default_channels.description: Channel names or IDs every new member gets.

enabled.description: true turns onboarding on, false turns it off.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

mode.description: default counts only default channels toward the constraints; advanced counts prompt option channels too.

prompts.description: The questions new members answer; each option grants channels and roles. Replaces the current prompts.

name: update_onboarding
title: Update onboarding
